title: Bryophytes
notes: Some of the basic features of bryophytes are given below: 1.
Bryophytes usually grow on damp, moist and shady places.
They form a green carpet on damp soil, rocks, walls and barks of trees.
5 BRYOPHYTA During the First World War, mosses were used as bandages due to its antiseptic properties making its perfect application in cleansing and healing the wound.
The plant body lacks true roots, stems or leaves and may have root-like, stem like or leaf like structure.
The plant body may be flat as in liverworts or tiny erect leafy structures on stalks, as in mosses.
The plant body of bryophytes is gametophyte since it produces gametes.
It is an independent, autotrophic and haploid.
